name: BSP_CameraPath_SampleWorld
evidence: Calls complete local sampler, captures actual +14 pose and refreshes canonical +C8/+CC if dirty, homogeneous float4 transform and rounded reciprocal-W position writes; re-reads +14 for optional unnormalized direction transform. Native ABI: ECX actual path; stack float parameter, position pointer, optional direction pointer, flags DWORD; RET10h; no meaningful return. Evidence: docs/CAMERA_PATH_SAMPLER.md; reports/camera_path_sampler.json. Descriptive name is a hypothesis.

name: BSP_WeaponController_HasOrdnanceOfKind
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_attack_commands; docs/ATTACK_COMMANDS.md and reports/attack_commands.json. int __thiscall(ECX = weapon controller)(int kind, int loadout). Loops the +994h slot count over the slot array at +974h, takes slot->vtable[220h](loadout) and asks descriptor->vtable[8](kind). The shared body of the six per-ordnance queries.

name: BSP_Matrix_GetMaximumBasisLengthSquared
evidence: [BSP reconstruction] For rows0/1/2, x87 computes x*x, y*y, combines ySquared+xSquared, then adds z*z and stores completed sum float. FCOMI/JC selects between rows0/1, then FCOMIP/JC compares selected row to row2. Carry includes unordered; equality retains earlier row. Ignores last column and translation. Native max-row rule, not spectral norm. Typed implementation retains instruction and float-store order. Original ABI: ECX=16-float matrix; x87 ST0=float result reloaded from float storage; RET. Evidence: docs/MODEL_WORLD_BOUNDS.md; reports/model_world_bounds_audit.json. Descriptive names are hypotheses; typed C++ interfaces are not native ABI or game validation.

name: BSP_UnitInstance_OnHit
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. 007BBCF0-007BBDBC, __thiscall(unit, HitRecord*). Clears unit+520h, sets unit+DFCh when the shooter at hit+4h passes vtable+5Ch with 5, refreshes the pose for the local player's unit, forwards to [unit+9D4h] vtable+ECh and 00999AA0, copies [[hit+38h]+4h] into unit+800h when hit+34h is not -1, then calls 008777D0 at 007BBDB1. Reached virtually; its slot and dispatcher are unread. docs/UNIT_HIT_PATH.md.
